headline: Spain Blank Belgium 2-0 and March into the Semis
whyCareReason: Possession kings against a Belgian side built to disrupt: a quarter-final that decided a semi-final berth in Atlanta.
teaser: Spain controlled the tempo and converted two clear chances to eliminate Belgium 2-0 in the quarter-finals.
story:
Spain arrived with the same patient, positional game that carried them through the group and Round of 16. Belgium sat deep, looked for transitions, and nearly stole the opener on a second-half break.

La Roja's midfield eventually found the gaps. Two well-worked goals rewarded their territorial dominance and punished Belgian fatigue late on. Belgium's stars created flashes, but Spain's structure never fully cracked.

At 2-0, the quarter-final was settled. Spain advance as one of the tournament's most coherent teams; Belgium's golden generation exits at the last eight.
stakes: Winner to the semi-finals. Loser goes home after a long knockout road.
rivalryAngle: Spain's possession school against Belgium's athletic counter-punch is a modern European classic.
funFacts: Spain are affectionately known as the La Roja.
Belgium are affectionately known as the Red Devils.
This high-profile match was held at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles on 2026-07-10.

headToHead: Historically, matches between these two nations have always been tightly contested affairs, with tactical discipline proving key.
